# FDG5026

> DO create get-only properties if the caller should not be able to change the value of the property.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.2 Property Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Not an analyzer candidate: whether callers should be able to change a value is a matter of intent.

## From the book

If the type of the property is a mutable reference type, the property value can be changed even if the property is get-only.
